jobs.title: Deal Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
Navan is seeking a Deal Strategy Manager, US to collaborate closely with our sales team in driving deal negotiations. This role is responsible for managing complex contract negotiations, aligning customer needs with Navan's strategic priorities, and partnering with internal sales and business teams throughout the contract signing process. As a key guardian of our US commercial strategy, you will balance revenue optimization with risk mitigation across a diverse, multi-market landscape.

We are looking for a commercial strategist who is genuinely passionate about the art of the deal!

What You’ll Do:

- Develop in-depth knowledge of Navan licensing and pricing models to provide deal structuring and quoting support to our global sales teams

- Work with the sales team to find creative ways to meet customers’ needs while adhering to Navan's commercial and financial guardrails

- Be a critical enabler of deal formation and execution, focusing on minimizing sales cycle times while optimizing revenue, profitability, and market share.

- Actively participate in external, customer-facing negotiations

- Work cross functionally across various stakeholder groups including legal, contracts, sales operations, order management, revenue, finance and product management

- Drive best practices to increase sales efficiency and effectiveness via deal reviews, early checkpoint and enforcement of standard business practices and policies

- Assist with non-standard deal requests, structuring sophisticated deals, driving cross-functional and cross solution teamwork and ensure revenue recognition requirements are handled

- Support metrics and processes to improve business visibility and consistency of practices across geographies

- Overseeing deal financials, pricing, business risk, revenue recognition implication

What We’re Looking For:

- Business degree and/or JD/ MBA

- 5+ years of software industry experience (Deal Desk, Finance, Sales Operations experience preferred)

- Customer facing experience

- Strong eye for business and proven track record in commercial negotiations

- Self-motivated and able to work under pressure; diligent with deliverables and deadlines, able to multitask

- Solid understanding of software revenue recognition principles

- Deep understanding of commercial law and experience in contract management

- Excellent interpersonal skills – verbal and written

- Strong analytical skills along with the ability to demonstrate practical judgment in sophisticated situations

- Strong ownership and collaboration skills, with the ability to interact regularly with senior management

- Proficient knowledge of Salesforce, CPQ

jobs.title: Director, Corporate Development
jobs.description:
Within Navan, Corporate Development is a small, nimble, “SEAL Team Six” at the center of driving and executing our M&A strategy.  Outside of M&A, we are often brought in on the most complex issues the company faces because we bring a structured, analytical approach to how best to proceed and deploy our resources.  The ideal candidate is excited to work with a variety of internal and external teams to tackle Navan’s trickiest and most interesting problems.

- Corporate Development is a fast moving, hyper-analytical team excited to move the needle at Navan and for travelers everywhere.

- Deep down, we’re truth-seeking, committed to making a difference, and want to work with super bright, high integrity people to do it.

- The end goal is meaningful work–scaling a world changing company–while building meaningful relationships.

What You’ll Do:

- Drive our strategy, execution, and deal implementation for domestic and increasingly global M&A.

- Collaborate with senior leaders to identify, structure, quantify, and answer complex business problems to help inform executive and board decisions.

- Develop relationships with leaders in product, finance, sales, and operations to understand their business needs and how M&A could help.

- Work closely with our partnership team to refine our long-term plan by partner, identify where we might want to take minority positions, and drive investment execution.

- Build deal-related models, including valuation, synergies, growth, and funding options.

- Create and implement PMI playbooks to maximize value post acquisition.

- Refine and monitor our competitive landscape.

- Help build out a world-class Corporate Development team from the ground up.

What We're Looking for:

- You’re an owner with a strong bias for action. You own the work you’re driving, end to end. You like to dive into details and ensure things run smoothly. Your true north is shaping our category by adding value for our customers; if you’re thrilled at the prospect of doing this, this role will be a great fit for you!

- You are super analytical, structured, and can break down complex problems into simple components. You are a black belt in Excel/Google Sheets, but are equally comfortable laying things out on the whiteboard or in slides.

- You have exceptional communication skills, business judgment, and the ability to tell compelling data-driven stories to senior leaders, including our C-suite and Board.

- You gravitate toward people and enjoy working in a highly cross-functional role. You can help engineering resolve a technical question in the morning, work with FP&A on a model in the afternoon, and negotiate a deal structure in the evening.

- You are very comfortable either modeling and structuring complex deals or driving cross-functional integration efforts after closing. A spike in at least one of these is preferred, while the other can be developed on the job.

- You have 6+ years in a comparable work environment—with evidence of high performance—including Banking, Consulting, Product Management, or VC/PE. Experience in another high-growth tech company is a plus, but not required.

jobs.title: Director of Strategic Finance, Europe
jobs.description:
Navan (Nasdaq: NAVN) is the leading all-in-one business travel, payments, and expense management platform. Our mission is to make travel easy for every frequent traveler by delivering an intuitive experience that travelers love and finance teams rely on. From AI-driven search to automated expense reconciliation, we help our customers focus on the human connections that drive their success. Our team is our competitive edge – a high-performance group of smart, driven people committed to winning together. At Navan, we provide an environment where top talent excels, offering the autonomy and fast-paced trajectory needed to build a defining career.

We are looking for a Director / Senior Director of Strategic Finance to act as the primary financial and commercial leader for our Signature Service organisation out of the UK. In this highly visible role, you will serve as the strategic right-hand to the CEO of Signature Services while driving critical global initiatives. You will lead complex structural integrations, shape our global pricing strategy, and build scalable frameworks that drive monetization and streamline commercial operations. We are seeking a dynamic, "commercial first" leader who thrives in ambiguity, commands the room with data-driven storytelling, and can seamlessly translate complex financial architecture into actionable business growth.  This role will not be responsible for treasury and accounting but would work cross functionally with their counterparts.

What You’ll Do

- European Leadership & Signature Services Business Partner: Serve as the core strategic finance partner to the CEO of Navan Signature Services, demonstrating strong partnership with executive leadership and exceptional executive communication skills on diverse regional projects. Fully own the financial strategy and execution for the signature services division to drive growth and profitability.

- Global Ecosystem Integration: Spearhead the global integration and strategic wind-down of legacy subsidiaries, exercising extensive cross-functional influence to ensure all international entities are seamlessly unified under a single, streamlined financial ecosystem.

- Global Market & Dynamic Pricing Strategy: Conceptualize and drive global go-to-market frameworks, leveraging deep experience in bespoke pricing and dynamic pricing strategies to adapt to varying market conditions and maximize revenue capture.

- Strategic Leadership & Monetization: Build and lead a high-performing pricing center of excellence; own the end-to-end monetization roadmap—integrating tiering, value-based pricing, and usage-based financial models —to drive NRR; and develop strict ROI frameworks ensuring product innovation directly translates to margin expansion.

- Commercial Operations & Deal Execution: Partner with Deal Desk and Sales leadership to architect high-value enterprise exceptions; design and deploy real-time automated pricing calculators to accelerate sales cycles; and own the scenario-modeling engines that provide account management with data-driven facts to optimize renewals and minimize churn.

What We’re Looking For

Experience & Education

- Leadership: 12+ years of experience in strategic finance, pricing, or commercial strategy, with at least 5 years in a leadership role within a high-growth technology or SaaS environment in Europe.

- Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, or a quantitative field. An MBA or advanced degree is highly preferred.

Technical & Analytical Skills

- Pricing Expertise: Deep understanding of SaaS monetization levers (usage-based, seat-based, tiered) and price elasticity modeling.

- Financial Powerhouse: Expert-level financial modeling and a mastery of SQL and data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, or similar).

- Systems Thinker: Experience optimizing pricing/CPQ tools and integrating them with financial planning systems (e.g., Pigment,, Salesforce).

Professional Attributes

- Executive Presence: Ability to command a room and influence C-suite decisions through data-driven storytelling and clear commercial logic.

- Negotiation Mindset: A "commercial first" approach to finance—you seek ways to say "yes" to deals while protecting the company’s bottom line.

- Detailed: Possesses the agility to zoom out for big-picture financial modeling and zoom in to ensure the integrity of the underlying data.

- Adaptability: Proven ability to build structure in ambiguous, fast-paced environments and a relentless bias for action.

jobs.title: Manager, Business Operations, Specialty Travel & Events
jobs.description:
The Specialty Travel & Events Business Operations team is built to solve our organization's most critical, emergent challenges across business, product, and operations. As a Manager-level individual contributor, you will have the unique opportunity to scope, design, and drive high-impact initiatives that support business growth, optimization, and stability.

This is a role for a first-principles thinker. You are someone who can look at a highly complex business challenge, map out the unseen connections between teams and systems, and help design a creative, elegant path forward. You aren't just managing projects; you are critically evaluating how our business runs, leveraging data to challenge assumptions, and driving the hands-on execution of some of our most important strategic initiatives.

What You'll Do

- Drive Strategic Initiatives: Execute on high-impact, 0-to-1 operational initiatives end-to-end. Investigate complex, ambiguous problems, develop rigorous work plans, and drive day-to-day execution.

- Solve Complex Systems Problems: Identify operational bottlenecks and help design scalable processes that allow cross-functional teams (Sales, Operations, Data Analytics, Finance, etc.) to work together seamlessly.

- Synthesize Data into Strategy: Dig into raw business data (using Excel, SQL, or other systems) to reveal patterns and truths behind operational challenges. Translate these findings into clear, actionable recommendations for leadership and cross-functional partners.

- Balance Trade-offs: Anticipate roadblocks and partner with leadership to find the right balance between strategic business goals and technical or financial constraints.

- Manage Change and Execution: Clearly communicate progress, manage stakeholder alignment, and guide cross-functional teams through process changes without losing momentum.

- Unblock and Accelerate: Anticipate technical bottlenecks, call out trade-offs between business desires and constraints, and keep project teams aligned and moving forward.

What We’re Looking For

- Experience: 4–6 years of experience in business operations, strategy, or a highly strategic cross-functional operations role in a fast-paced environment.

- Influence Without Authority: Proven track record of managing cross-functional relationships, building alignment, and driving results across diverse teams without direct management authority.

- Analytical Tooling: Strong comfort with data. You should be highly proficient in Excel/Google Sheets and comfortable using SQL (or eager to leverage it) to query databases, join tables, and extract your own insights.

- Education: BA or BS degree (or equivalent practical experience).

- Natural Systems Thinker: You intuitively see how different parts of an organization, workflow, and technology stack interconnect. You don't build temporary "band-aid" fixes; you design systems that hold complex, interdependent relationships in balance.

- Intellectual Humility & Curiosity: You approach problems with a "beginner’s mind." You have the self-critical awareness to challenge your own initial assumptions, ask deeply thoughtful questions before forming a plan, and actively seek out diverse perspectives to find the best solution.

- Data-Driven Critical Thinker: You don't make decisions based on gut feel alone. You are energized by messy, fragmented data, and you know how to ask the right questions, connect the dots, and find the narrative within a raw dataset.

- High Momentum (Anti-"Swirl"): You move quickly and decisively. While you are thorough, you do not get caught in analysis paralysis or allow yourself to be dragged sideways by organizational noise. You know how to maintain focus and keep projects moving forward.

- Collaborative & Growth-Minded: You love being in rooms with brilliant people who challenge you. Instead of feeling intimidated, you use those environments as fuel to grow, learn, and elevate your own capabilities.

Preferred Experience

- Prior experience in business operations or strategic program management in a high-growth tech environment.

- Experience driving organizational change management alongside system or process rollouts.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Strategy & Innovation
jobs.description:
Navan is the all-in-one super app that makes travel and expense easy so you can focus on being there, not getting there. As we scale our global footprint, we are revolutionizing not just corporate travel, but workforce management.

The Resource Orchestration Center (ROC) is the proactive, AI-powered "Enterprise Brain" of our 1,000-agent, 24/7 global travel operation. We rely on an advanced technology stack—including Genesys Cloud, Snowflake data lakes, ThoughtSpot, and AI-driven analytics—to automate administrative tasks and empower our human talent. We don't just report on what happened; we engineer outcomes to guarantee our elite service level agreements (SLAs) for our global travelers.

As the Senior Manager, Strategy & Innovation, you sit at the critical intersection of long-term service capacity planning, strategic project management, and internal operational excellence. Moving beyond standard workforce management, this role is designed for a visionary leader who will build and guide a global team consisting of Capacity Strategists and Process Improvement Leads.

You will partner directly with Operations and Product leaders to build precise service agent capacity models, drive large-scale travel support projects, and continuously map and optimize the internal workflows of the ROC team itself. Your goal is to ensure the ROC operates as a lean, exception-based intelligence hub that seamlessly supports our global travel enterprise.

What You’ll Do:

Project Management & Cross-Functional Partnering

- Direct end-to-end project management for major ROC initiatives, new service offering deployments, Crisis Management, and strategic overhauls.

- Serve as the liaison to Customer Experience, Sales, and Account Management, translating complex workforce capacity data into actionable travel business intelligence.

- Drive alignment across departments during new customer launches and travel market expansions to ensure the ROC is operationally ready to support the business.

Service Capacity Strategy & Workforce Architecture

- Lead a team of Capacity Strategists to build comprehensive service agent capacity plans based on seasonal travel trends.

- Master the complex mathematics of agent staffing by accurately modeling Required FTE vs. Productive FTE, factoring in detailed multi-variable shrinkage to ensure the agents are always appropriately staffed.

- Design and optimize the overarching portfolio management strategy, ensuring that agent tiers (Core, Designated, Dedicated, Specialty Travel) are dynamically planned for to meet shifting business priorities.

Internal ROC Process Optimization & Leadership

- Lead and develop a team of Process Improvement Leads (USA) entirely dedicated to optimizing the internal workflows, tools, and daily operating procedures of the ROC team.

- Execute detailed journey mapping for ROC analysts to identify bottlenecks, eliminate administrative waste, and establish Lean/Six Sigma methodologies within our own department.

- Oversee root-cause analysis (RCA) initiatives for internal operational misses, ensuring that systemic fixes are implemented to improve the ROC's efficiency and accuracy in supporting the travel network.

AI Ideation & Technology Partnership

- Identify internal operational friction points within the ROC and partner closely with our specialized WFM technology team to hand off requirements for new AI and automation solutions.

- Serve as a key voice in cross-functional discussions on how automation and AI integration can enhance the experience for frontline travel agents, as well as eliminate manual effort for the ROC analysts and planners.

- Champion the transition to a fully "exception-based" Command Center by ensuring ROC business needs drive the technology roadmap (e.g., Snowflake data ingestion, ThoughtSpot applications).

What We’re Looking For:

- Experience: 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in Operations Strategy, Project Management, and/or Advanced Workforce Management.

- Project & Process Management: Strong background in leading complex, cross-functional projects and journey-mapping internal department workflows. PMP or Agile/Scrum certification is a strong plus.

- Communication & Influence: Elite executive storytelling skills, with the ability to build consensus across VP-level stakeholders in disparate departments.

- Technology Partnership: Strong ability to bridge the gap between ROC business operations and technical engineering teams. Understanding of modern data architectures (Snowflake) and BI/AI tools (ThoughtSpot, Power BI) to effectively collaborate on tech roadmaps.

- Advanced Capacity Modeling: Deep understanding of short and long term forecasting and service agent capacity planning, multi-variable shrinkage modeling, and immediate to long term hiring plan architecture.

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Industrial Engineering, Statistics, or a related field. MBA or advanced degree is highly preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
We are seeking a skilled and experienced Marketing Operations Manager to join our team. The ideal candidate will play a pivotal role in optimizing marketing operations, driving efficiency, and enhancing the effectiveness of our campaigns. This individual will leverage their expertise in tools like Marketo and Salesforce to manage campaigns, streamline processes, and contribute to Navan’s growth trajectory.

This is a global role requiring close collaboration with teams in different time zones, including regular interaction with colleagues in Israel.

What You’ll Do:

- Oversee and manage the configuration, maintenance, and hands-on creation of campaigns in Marketo, ensuring strategic alignment and flawless execution.

- Ensure seamless integration and functionality of the marketing technology stack, aligned with business objectives.

- Optimize marketing and sales processes to enhance efficiency, scalability, and effectiveness.

- Collaborate with marketing, sales, and other teams across time zones to drive integrated campaigns and improve data quality.

- Monitor and refine lead enrichment, scoring, and qualification processes to improve lead management.

- Develop and maintain reporting, dashboards, and analysis to support data-driven decisions.

- Manage data governance and ensure compliance with data privacy regulations in global markets.

What We're Looking For:

- Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business administration, or a related field is preferred; equivalent professional experience in marketing operations or technology will also be considered.

- 3-5+ years of experience in marketing operations, ideally in global SaaS or technology companies.

- 2+ years of hands-on experience configuring and managing campaigns in Marketo and Salesforce CRM, with a proven track record of optimizing engagement for large-scale databases.

- Deep understanding of lead management, campaign optimization, and marketing analytics.

- Expertise in database management, platform integrations, and marketing technology tools (experience with Full Circle Insights, ThoughtSpot, outreach, or Chili Piper is a plus).

- Strategic thinker with excellent communication skills, able to effectively manage projects and collaborate across global teams.

- Marketo certification and familiarity with attribution modeling are strong advantages.

Additional Expectations:

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

- Willingness to align working hours with a global based team, including early mornings or late evenings, as required.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
Navan is searching for a dynamic and results-driven Senior Program Manager to join our Strategy & Operations team. Reporting directly to the Director of Strategy & Operations, this is a highly visible, high-impact role designed for a leader who excels at turning high-level business strategy into flawless operational execution.

In this role, you will act as the connective tissue across Navan’s core business functions—partnering closely with Product, Go-To-Market (GTM), Engineering, and Customer Success to drive our most critical, complex initiatives. You will be responsible for orchestrating cross-functional programs from inception to delivery, navigating ambiguity with ease, and building the scalable processes required to support Navan’s rapid global growth. If you are a strategic thinker who loves rolling up your sleeves to solve complex operational puzzles, we want you on our team.

What You’ll Do:

- Drive Strategic Initiatives: Lead the end-to-end execution of top-tier, cross-functional corporate programs that directly support Navan’s strategic roadmap and revenue goals.

- Orchestrate Cross-Functional Alignment: Serve as the primary driver and central point of contact for complex projects, seamlessly aligning stakeholders across GTM, Product, Operations, and Finance to ensure unified execution.

- Establish Operational Rigor: Build and manage comprehensive program plans, define clear KPIs, and establish a regular operating cadence (e.g., steering committees, status reports, QBRs) to keep teams accountable and on track.

- Identify and Mitigate Risk: Proactively spot roadblocks, dependencies, and operational bottlenecks before they impact delivery. Escalate thoughtfully to the Director of Strategy & Operations and executive sponsors with proposed, data-backed solutions.

- Process Optimization: Continuously evaluate our internal workflows. Design, implement, and iterate on scalable processes that improve cross-team velocity and operational efficiency as Navan grows.

- Executive Communication: Translate complex project updates, risks, and data into crisp, actionable insights for senior leadership and C-suite stakeholders.

- Champion Change Management: Ensure new processes, systems, and strategies are effectively rolled out and adopted across the organization through clear communication and enablement.

What We’re Looking For:

- Experience: 6+ years of progressive experience in program management, business operations, strategy, or management consulting, preferably within a fast-paced B2B SaaS, hyper-growth tech, or fintech environment.

- Execution Powerhouse: A proven track record of successfully leading complex, multi-departmental programs from concept to launch with measurable business impact.

- Analytical & Data-Driven: You don’t just track tasks; you measure outcomes. You are highly comfortable using data to inform program strategy, measure success, and diagnose operational issues.

- Influence Without Authority: Exceptional stakeholder management skills. You can motivate, align, and drive consensus among cross-functional leaders and individual contributors alike, even when they don't report to you.

- Communicate with Candor: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. You can distill complex programmatic details into clear executive summaries and are comfortable presenting to senior leadership.

- Comfort with Ambiguity: You thrive in dynamic, fast-changing environments. When the path isn't perfectly clear, you take the initiative to define it, bringing structure to chaos.

- Operational Urgency: You possess a strong bias for action. You balance a strategic mindset with the tactical grit needed to get things done quickly and to a high standard.

- Education & Certifications: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Management, or a related field. PMP, Agile, or Lean Six Sigma certifications are a plus, but practical, proven experience is paramount.

jobs.title: Sr. Analyst, GTM Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
As a Revenue Operations Senior Analyst, you will support the optimization of our Account Management (AM) team’s strategy and execution. You will be a critical analytical partner for the AM leadership team, supporting the functional areas covered by GTM Strategy & Ops: business partnership, analytics, systems & tools, processes & programs. In this role, you will help identify and execute the analytical frameworks needed by the AM organization to ensure they operate efficiently and effectively to achieve their targets and drive company revenue.

Your work will span areas such as: annual planning (e.g., modeling team structures, coverage models, and target setting), ad-hoc analyses and projects to drive optimization (e.g., diagnosing changes in metrics, identifying new GTM opportunities), day-to-day operations, process improvement, program execution, and systems and tooling (e.g., administration, data hygiene, and reporting).

What You’ll Do:

- Act as a key analytical partner to Account management leadership, working collaboratively on data-driven GTM Strategy and Operations topics required to run the AM teams, including: annual planning models, GTM structure modeling, incentive program design and tracking, process improvement, and day-to-day support.

- Maintain and deliver recurring performance reporting that drive the business forward

- Support the execution of projects and programs across these initiatives through your own analytical work, collaborating with other GTM Strategy & Ops teams (e.g., Analytics) and cross-functional teams (e.g., Marketing, Finance).

- Provide data-informed insights and recommendations to leadership by identifying trends, anomalies, and optimization opportunities.

- Be accountable for the accuracy and delivery of insights for the segment, enabling the AM organization to meet their objectives by creating a consistent ecosystem of process and reporting.

- Utilize technology platforms (e.g. Salesforce, Gong) to enhance team productivity and reporting accuracy.

What We’re Looking For:

- 3–5+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales, consulting, or a related field

- Proven track record of delivering analytical models and managing workstreams within complex, cross-functional programs.

- Deep technical understanding of sales processes and tools, with advanced proficiency in Salesforce CRM (reports, dashboards, and data structure).

- Exceptional Excel/Google Sheets and analytical skills, with the ability to translate complex data sets into actionable insights.

- Proficiency in SQL for performing advanced data extraction and complex analysis is a strong plus.

- Experience with AI-driven tools or workflow, whether for process automation, predictive modeling, or enhancing GTM efficiency is highly valued

- Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to present data clearly to stakeholders at various levels.

- Experience building metrics and reporting systems to measure the impact and effectiveness of GTM initiatives.

- Collaborative mindset with a strong ability to work across teams to ensure data consistency.

- Self-starter with exceptional multitasking skills, able to handle deep-dive analysis while maintaining swift execution on daily tasks.

- Experience in fast-paced, SaaS, or startup environments is highly preferred.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Manager, Specialty Travel & Events
jobs.description:
About the Role

Navan is looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to help drive execution across Specialty Travel & Events. The Specialty Travel & Events team owns verticals including Professional Services, Healthcare Professionals, Production and Media, and others. This role will lead cross-functional initiatives to further mature these service offerings, advancing Navan’s mission to make travel easy for every frequent traveler.

In this role, you will work closely with the Strategy & Operations Director to translate strategic priorities into clear plans, coordinate stakeholders across the organisation, build quantitative analyses and dashboards, and help ensure leadership has a reliable view of performance, progress, risks, and decisions.

What You'll Do

Cross-functional programme leadership

- You will lead complex, cross-functional initiatives to improve and scale Specialty Travel & Events service offerings, consistent with the organisation’s biggest priorities.

- Build strong relationships across the organisation and create alignment among stakeholders with different priorities. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Finance, and other teams across the organisation.

- Identify risks, resolve blockers, and escalate decisions with sound judgement and appropriate urgency.

Drive strategic initiatives for senior leadership

- Partner closely with the Strategy & Operations Director and senior leaders to turn emerging priorities into focused initiatives and measurable outcomes.

- Support the development and ongoing management of leadership operating cadences, including priority-setting, business reviews, and follow-up mechanisms.

- Take ownership of high-priority, ambiguous projects that arise from changing business needs.

Leverage business insights to solve problems

- Partner with Finance and Revenue Operations to build analyses, dashboards, and reporting to understand business performance.

- Develop reporting that gives leaders and cross-functional teams a clear view of performance and progress.

- Leverage these insights to inform executive decisions.

Who You Are

- 4–6 years of professional experience in strategy and operations, business operations, programme management, consulting, or a related field. Experience in a high-growth tech company is strongly preferred.

- Strong project management skills and a track record of delivering through others without relying on formal authority.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.

- Comfort operating in a fast-changing environment with competing priorities.

- High emotional intelligence, discretion, resilience, and a collaborative working style.

- Demonstrated quantitative and analytical skills a plus, including experience building analyses and business intelligence reporting.

People who thrive at Navan tend to move quickly, are self-sufficient, demonstrate good judgement, and have strong emotional intelligence.
